local function GetSafeParent()
    if gethui then return gethui() end
    if syn and syn.protect_gui then
        local f = Instance.new("Folder")
        syn.protect_gui(f)

        return f
    end
    return CoreGui
end

local Dragging, DragInput, DragStart, StartPos

        Dragging = true

        StartPos = MainFrame.Position

end)

end)

local function CreateToggle(title, defaultState, callback)

    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)
    Label.TextSize = 11
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    Switch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -46, 0.5, -9)
    Switch.BackgroundColor3 = defaultState and Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    Switch.Parent = ToggleFrame

    local SwitchCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

    SwitchCorner.Parent = Switch

    local Circle = Instance.new("Frame")
    Circle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
    Circle.Position = defaultState and UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7)
    Circle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Circle.Parent = Switch

    local CircleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    CircleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    CircleCorner.Parent = Circle

    local State = defaultState
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    Button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Button.Text = ""
    Button.Parent = ToggleFrame

    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        State = not State
        TweenService:Create(Switch, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundColor3 = State and Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(Circle, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Position = State and UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7)}):Play()
        callback(State)
    end)
end

        TweenService:Create(ButtonFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 36)}):Play()

local function CreateSlider(title, min, max, default, callback)
    local SliderFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    SliderFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46)
    SliderFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 28)
    SliderFrame.Parent = MainScroll

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    Corner.Parent = SliderFrame

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 22)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 2)
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Label.Text = title:lower()
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)
    Label.TextSize = 11
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.Parent = SliderFrame

    local ValLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    ValLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, -10, 0, 22)
    ValLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 2)
    ValLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ValLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    ValLabel.Text = tostring(default)
    ValLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255)
    ValLabel.TextSize = 11
    ValLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    ValLabel.Parent = SliderFrame

    local Track = Instance.new("Frame")
    Track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 5)
    Track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 30)
    Track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    Track.Parent = SliderFrame

    local Fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    Fill.Size = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
    Fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255)
    Fill.Parent = Track

    local Active = false
    local function Update(input)
        local Relative = math.clamp((input.Position.X - Track.AbsolutePosition.X) / Track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local Value = math.floor(min + (max - min) * Relative)
        Fill.Size = UDim2.new(Relative, 0, 1, 0)
        ValLabel.Text = tostring(Value)
        callback(Value)
    end

    Track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            Active = true
            Update(input)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            Active = false
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if Active and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            Update(input)
        end
    end)
end

local function SmoothMoveTo(targetCFrame, speed)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    local dist = (hrp.Position - targetCFrame.Position).Magnitude
    local duration = math.max(0.01, dist / (speed or 85))

    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(hrp, tweenInfo, {CFrame = targetCFrame})
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Wait()
end

local function GetAllEntities()
    local entities = {}
    local searchedContainers = {
        Workspace:FindFirstChild("Entities"),
        Workspace:FindFirstChild("Monsters"),
        Workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawns"),
        Workspace
    }

    local function ScanContainer(container)
        if not container then return end
        for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Model") then
                if item:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or item:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or item:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                    if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(item) then
                        table.insert(entities, item)
                    end
                else
                    ScanContainer(item)
                end
            elseif item:IsA("Folder") then
                ScanContainer(item)
            elseif item:IsA("BasePart") and item.Name:lower():find("monster") then
                table.insert(entities, item)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, c in ipairs(searchedContainers) do
        if c then ScanContainer(c) end
    end

    local unique = {}
    local hash = {}
    for _, ent in ipairs(entities) do
        if not hash[ent] then
            hash[ent] = true
            table.insert(unique, ent)
        end
    end

    return unique
end

local CurrentPreviewClone = nil
local RotateAngle = 0

local function ClearPreview()
    ViewportWorld:ClearAllChildren()
    CurrentPreviewClone = nil
end

local function LoadMonsterInPreview(monsterModel)
    ClearPreview()
    if not monsterModel or not (monsterModel:IsA("Model") or monsterModel:IsA("BasePart")) then return end

    local clone = monsterModel:Clone()
    for _, scriptObj in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
        if scriptObj:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then scriptObj:Destroy() end
    end

    clone.Parent = ViewportWorld
    CurrentPreviewClone = clone

    local primary = clone:IsA("BasePart") and clone or (clone.PrimaryPart or clone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or clone:FindFirstChild("Head") or clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
    if primary then
        if clone:IsA("Model") then
            local humanoid = clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or Instance.new("Humanoid", clone)
            local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)

            local origAnim = monsterModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animation") or monsterModel:FindFirstChild("Run") or monsterModel:FindFirstChild("Walk")
            if origAnim and origAnim:IsA("Animation") then
                local track = animator:LoadAnimation(origAnim)
                track.Looped = true
                track:Play()
            end
        end
        ViewportLight.Parent = primary
    end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if CurrentPreviewClone then
        local primary = CurrentPreviewClone:IsA("BasePart") and CurrentPreviewClone or (CurrentPreviewClone.PrimaryPart or CurrentPreviewClone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or CurrentPreviewClone:FindFirstChild("Head") or CurrentPreviewClone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
        if primary then
            RotateAngle = RotateAngle + 0.015
            local dist = 10
            local x = primary.Position.X + math.cos(RotateAngle) * dist
            local z = primary.Position.Z + math.sin(RotateAngle) * dist
            ViewportCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(x, primary.Position.Y + 2, z), primary.Position)
        end
    end
end)

local function PopulateMonsterShowcase()
    for _, c in ipairs(MonsterListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end
    end

    local entities = GetAllEntities()
    if #entities > 0 then
        for idx, ent in ipairs(entities) do
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 30)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 36)
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            btn.Text = "  " .. ent.Name:lower() .. " [" .. tostring(idx) .. "]"
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)
            btn.TextSize = 11
            btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            btn.Parent = MonsterListFrame

            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            c.Parent = btn

            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                LoadMonsterInPreview(ent)
                Notify("showcase", "showing: " .. ent.Name:lower())
            end)
        end
    else
        Notify("showcase", "no entities found in workspace")
    end
end

CreateHeader("event survivals")

local AutoDodgerActive = false
local AutoDodgeDist = 25
local AntiInvisActive = false
local AlertSoundActive = false
local AutoDollyActive = false

CreateToggle("auto dodge", false, function(v)
    AutoDodgerActive = v
    if v then
        task.spawn(function()
            Notify("event survivals", "auto dodger on")
            while AutoDodgerActive do
                task.wait(0.1)
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                if hrp and hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude == 0 then
                    local entities = GetAllEntities()
                    for _, ent in ipairs(entities) do
                        if not AutoDodgerActive then break end
                        local ePart = ent:IsA("BasePart") and ent or (ent:IsA("Model") and (ent.PrimaryPart or ent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or ent:FindFirstChild("Head") or ent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")))
                        if ePart then
                            local dist = (ePart.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                            if dist < AutoDodgeDist then
                                local dodgeDir = (hrp.Position - ePart.Position).Unit
                                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position + (dodgeDir * 6), hrp.Position + dodgeDir * 10)
                                Notify("auto dodge", "dodged monster")
                                task.wait(0.2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

CreateSlider("auto dodge radius", 10, 50, 25, function(v)

                        if ePart then

                                sound.Parent = Workspace
                                sound:Play()
                                task.wait(1.5)
                                sound:Destroy()
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

local function GetDebrisFolder()
    local debris = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris") or Workspace:FindFirstChild("debris")
    if debris then
        local mapInDebris = debris:FindFirstChild("Map") or debris:FindFirstChild("map")
        if mapInDebris then
            return mapInDebris
        end
        return debris
    end

    local mapFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or Workspace:FindFirstChild("map")
    if mapFolder then
        return mapFolder:FindFirstChild("Debris") or mapFolder:FindFirstChild("debris") or mapFolder
    end

    return Workspace
end

local function GetClosestScrap(hrp)
    local targetContainer = GetDebrisFolder()
    if not targetContainer then return nil end

    local closest, minDistance = nil, math.huge
    for _, item in ipairs(targetContainer:GetDescendants()) do
        local part = nil
        if item:IsA("BasePart") then
            part = item
        elseif item:IsA("Model") then
            part = item.PrimaryPart or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        end

        if part and item.Parent and part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
            local dist = (part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < minDistance then
                minDistance = dist
                closest = {Item = item, Part = part}
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local function IsPlayerDowned(player)
    if not player or not player.Character then return false end
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hum and (hum.Health <= 0 or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead) then
        return true
    end

    if DownedModule then
        local success, downedResult = pcall(function()
            local moduleTable = require(DownedModule)
            if type(moduleTable) == "function" then
                return moduleTable(player) or moduleTable(char)
            elseif type(moduleTable) == "table" then
                if moduleTable.IsDowned then return moduleTable.IsDowned(player) end
                if moduleTable.Check then return moduleTable.Check(player) end
                if moduleTable[player] or moduleTable[player.Name] then return true end
            end
            return false
        end)
        if success and downedResult == true then
            return true
        end
    end

    local hasDownedAttr = char:GetAttribute("Downed") == true 
                       or char:GetAttribute("IsDowned") == true 
                       or char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
                       or char:GetAttribute("KO") == true
    
    local isRagdolled = char:FindFirstChild("Ragdoll") ~= nil or char:FindFirstChild("Downed") ~= nil
    return hasDownedAttr or isRagdolled
end

-- Real-time RenderStepped update loop for direction-accurate tracking arrows
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not ArrowToMonstersActive then 
        ClearArrows()
        return 
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not head or not cam then
        ClearArrows()
        return
    end

    local entities = GetAllEntities()
    local currentEntities = {}

    for idx, ent in ipairs(entities) do
        currentEntities[ent] = true
        local targetPart = ent:IsA("BasePart") and ent or (ent:IsA("Model") and (ent.PrimaryPart or ent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or ent:FindFirstChild("Head") or ent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")))

        if targetPart then
            local arrowGui = ArrowCache[ent]
            if not arrowGui or not arrowGui.Parent then
                arrowGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                arrowGui.Name = "MonsterArrowGui"
                arrowGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
                arrowGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
                arrowGui.Adornee = head
                arrowGui.Parent = MainGui

                local arrowImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                arrowImg.Name = "Arrow"
                arrowImg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
                arrowImg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 0.5, -12)
                arrowImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                arrowImg.Image = "rbxassetid://6034818372"
                arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                arrowImg.Parent = arrowGui

                local distLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                distLbl.Name = "Dist"
                distLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
                distLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -10)
                distLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                distLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                distLbl.TextSize = 9
                distLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                distLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
                distLbl.Parent = arrowGui

                ArrowCache[ent] = arrowGui
            end

            -- Alternates arrows on the sides of player head to avoid overlapping
            local isEven = (idx % 2 == 0)
            local sideMultiplier = isEven and 1 or -1
            local stackOffset = math.floor((idx - 1) / 2) * 1.2
            local xOffset = sideMultiplier * (2.2 + stackOffset)
            local yOffset = 1.5

            arrowGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(xOffset, yOffset, 0)

            -- ACCURATE POINT-AT-TARGET ROTATION MATH
            local targetPos = targetPart.Position
            local dist = math.floor((targetPos - head.Position).Magnitude)
            
            -- Compute angle using camera-relative coordinate space
            local localDir = cam.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(targetPos - cam.CFrame.Position)
            local angle = math.atan2(-localDir.X, -localDir.Z)

            local arrowImg = arrowGui:FindFirstChild("Arrow")
            local distLbl = arrowGui:FindFirstChild("Dist")

            if arrowImg then
                arrowImg.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
                if dist < 30 then
                    arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
                elseif dist < 70 then
                    arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 30)
                else
                    arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120)
                end
            end

            if distLbl then
                distLbl.Text = tostring(dist) .. "m"
            end
        end
    end

    -- Clean up despawned entity arrows
    for ent, arrowGui in pairs(ArrowCache) do
        if not currentEntities[ent] or not ent.Parent then
            if arrowGui and arrowGui.Parent then arrowGui:Destroy() end
            ArrowCache[ent] = nil
        end
    end
end)

local function RefreshPOVS()
    for _, child in ipairs(MonsterScroll:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end
    for _, child in ipairs(PlayerScroll:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end

    local entities = GetAllEntities()
    for idx, ent in ipairs(entities) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 26)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 25, 30)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        btn.Text = "watch monster: " .. ent.Name:lower() .. " [" .. tostring(idx) .. "]"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
        btn.TextSize = 11
        btn.Parent = MonsterScroll

        local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        c.Parent = btn

        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            POVTarget = ent
            ViewingPOV = true
            SetCameraTarget(ent)
            Notify("pov system", "spectating monster: " .. ent.Name:lower())
        end)
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 26)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 35, 45)
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            btn.Text = "watch player: " .. p.Name:lower()
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)
            btn.TextSize = 11
            btn.Parent = PlayerScroll

            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            c.Parent = btn

            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                POVTarget = p.Character
                ViewingPOV = true
                SetCameraTarget(p.Character)
                Notify("pov system", "spectating player: " .. p.Name:lower())
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function TeleportToNearestAlivePlayer()
    if IsPlayerDowned(LocalPlayer) then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    local nearest, minDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local pHum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local pHrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if pHum and pHum.Health > 0 and pHrp and not IsPlayerDowned(p) then
                local dist = (pHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < minDist then
                    minDist = dist
                    nearest = pHrp
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if nearest then
        hrp.CFrame = nearest.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
        Notify("downed tp", "teleported to nearest alive player: " .. nearest.Parent.Name:lower())
    end
end

local function HideInSmartSpot()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    local mapFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("MapFolder")
    local mainMap = mapFolder and mapFolder:FindFirstChild("Main")

    if mainMap then
        local validSpots = {}
        for _, part in ipairs(mainMap:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Size.Y > 4 and part.CanCollide then
                table.insert(validSpots, part)
            end
        end

        if #validSpots > 0 then
            local chosen = validSpots[math.random(1, #validSpots)]
            hrp.CFrame = chosen.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, chosen.Size.Y/2 + 3, 0)
            Notify("smart hide", "placed character in map hiding spot")
            return
        end
    end

    hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 20, 0)
    Notify("smart hide", "map main folder not found, teleported up")
end

local function FreeCharacterFromDolly()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hrp then
        hrp.Anchored = false
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored = false end
        end
    end
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end
    Notify("dolly event", "freed character from dolly lock")
end

local function SetupSoundListener(sound)
    if not sound or not sound:IsA("Sound") then return end

    sound.Played:Connect(function()
        local sId = sound.SoundId
        local sName = sound.Name:lower()

        if AutoDollyActive and (sName == "look" or sId:find("86427561503613")) then
            FreeCharacterFromDolly()
        end

        if sName == "downedmus" or sId:find("124126285504791") then
            TeleportToNearestAlivePlayer()
        end

        if sName == "spawnextrainindicator" or sId:find("131800688834543") then
            HideInSmartSpot()
        end
    end)
end
